name: home-videos-server
description: A tiny self-hosted home video library

scripts.dev: mkdir -p data && docker build -q -t home-videos-server:dev . && docker run --rm -it --init -p "${PORT:-3000}:3000" --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e MEDIA_DIR=/media -e "TZ=${TZ:-UTC}" -v "$PWD/server:/app/server" -v "$PWD/frontend:/app/frontend" -v "$PWD/data/test:/media" home-videos-server:dev node --watch server/server.ts
